threads.title: Discuss: Best 2D Game Engines
threads.author: GA Forum editorial team
threads.body_html:
Our ranking of 2D game engines puts GameMaker first, Godot second and Defold third, out of 10 products we checked on their own pages.

A ranking of engines and frameworks built for flat games: sprites, tilemaps, scene tools and the platforms each one can ship to.

If you have shipped with one of them, what broke first, and what would you rank higher?
